purpose: Fraud Scoring protects Meridian Pay and its merchants from payment fraud by evaluating payments in milliseconds to make risk decisions.

components.name: payment-events topic (MSK)
components.evidence: The payment-events topic (MSK) delivers one event for every payment

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: The scoring-engine reads each event, computes a score with the current model

components.name: decisions-db
components.evidence: decisions-db keeps every decision together with the customer attributes that were scored

components.name: fraud analysts
components.evidence: Decisions of the type review are collected into a queue that the fraud analysts work through every morning
